name: aiac
description: CLI and Go library that generates infrastructure-as-code, configuration files and ops scripts from a plain-language request.
whatItDoes: Produces Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, Dockerfiles, CI pipelines, policy code and shell snippets on request. DevOps engineers use it to draft templates and then refine them in a follow-up chat.
howItWorks: The request is sent to a backend defined in a TOML configuration file, which can name several backends and models. The reply is shown in the terminal, where the user can keep chatting, save the code to a file or copy it. The same logic is importable as a Go package.

requirements.name: Backend configuration
requirements.description: Backends and their credentials are declared in ~/.config/aiac/aiac.toml

run: aiac terraform for a highly available eks
